title: Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.15050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study online convex optimization with dueling (pairwise comparison) feedback, where the learner observes only a binary preference between two queried points. While dueling feedback is well understood in discrete or stochastic settings, the adversarial convex setting has remained unexplored. We propose a simple reduction that converts dueling feedback into approximate gradients, enabling the use of standard first-order methods. We show that regret guarantees transfer under this reduction, yielding the first results for this setting, including $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ static, adaptive, and dynamic regret. Under additional structure, we obtain improved rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ for smooth objectives and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$ for strongly convex functions.

translated_title: 在线凸优化与决斗反馈
translated_abstract: 我们研究了带有决斗（成对比较）反馈的在线凸优化问题，其中学习者仅能观察到两个查询点之间的二元偏好。尽管决斗反馈在离散或随机设置中已被充分理解，但对抗性凸设置仍未得到探索。我们提出了一种简单的归约方法，将决斗反馈转换为近似梯度，从而能够使用标准的一阶方法。我们表明，在这种归约下，遗憾保证可以转移，为该设置提供了首个结果，包括$\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$的静态、自适应和动态遗憾。在额外结构下，我们获得了改进的速率：对于光滑目标为$\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$，对于强凸函数为$\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$。
tldr: 本文首次将决斗反馈应用于对抗性凸优化，通过简单归约转换为近似梯度，实现了静态、自适应和动态遗憾的最优保证，并在光滑和强凸条件下获得改进速率。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to apply dueling feedback to adversarial convex optimization, converting it into approximate gradients via a simple reduction, achieving optimal static, adaptive, and dynamic regret guarantees with improved rates under smoothness and strong convexity.
